# Third-party data in the classic maps

The files `*-nav.js` here are generated by `tools/maps/extract-nav.mjs` from two MIT-licensed sources:

1. **awpy navigation data** (heights, floors, place names, connections) — github.com/pnxenopoulos/awpy, commit a5434abc06, `awpy/data/nav/nav_info.csv`, `de_<map>.txt`, `awpy/data/map/map_data.json`. MIT, Peter Xenopoulos.
2. **Lexogrine radar overviews** (sampled into the per-cell floor / wall / cover / site mask; the images themselves are not shipped) — github.com/lexogrine/csgo-react-hud, commit 2c6bbaa31e (2024-10-16), `src/HUD/Radar/LexoRadar/maps/de_<map>/radar.png` and `index.ts` (the image transform; Nuke's upper and lower levels). MIT, Lexogrine — all eight maps.

The map layouts themselves are Valve's designs (Counter-Strike: Global Offensive); the navigation meshes and overviews above are derived from Valve's game files.
